remarks: Welcome to the Hayes House, and experience this wonderfully updated 3BR, 2BA, 1525 square foot unit. Open and airy with terrific light, beautifully refinished hardwood floors throughout, completely redone bathrooms, lovely all wood galley kitchen w/new refrigerator, new built in oven, new sink and a dishwasher. The spacious living area is large enough for a full dining room as well. All new HVAC systems 1 year old, all new lighting fixtures as well as hardware in kitchen and all doors, built in office in one bedroom. Tons of closet space, extra storage unit and dedicated parking space. Outdoor common space for BBQ/Parties, community room, and bicycle room. 24 hour front doorman plus live in building super.
